questions.question: Mountain climbing
questions.solution: 'Alpinism' is the sport or activity of climbing high mountains.

questions.question: A similarity between like features of two things, on which a comparison may be based:
questions.solution: Analogy is a comparison between two things for explanation. Hindi: दो चीजों के बीच समानता के आधार पर तुलना।

questions.question: A person who has had one or more limbs removed:
questions.solution: An amputee is a person who has lost a limb by amputation. Hindi: वह व्यक्ति जिसका कोई अंग (हाथ या पैर) काट दिया गया हो।

questions.question: Formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution
questions.solution: Abolish means to officially end a law or system. (किसी प्रथा या कानून को समाप्त करना)

questions.question: Having or showing both good and bad feelings towards someone or something:
questions.solution: Ambivalent means having mixed feelings. Hindi: किसी के प्रति एक ही समय में अच्छे और बुरे दोनों विचार होना।

questions.question: A word or a phrase formed by rearranging the letters of a different word:
questions.solution: Anagram is formed by shuffling letters (e.g., 'Silent' to 'Listen'). Hindi: किसी शब्द के अक्षरों को आगे-पीछे करके बनाया गया नया शब्द।

questions.question: A place where animals are slaughtered for consumption as food
questions.solution: Abattoir is a place where animals are killed for meat. (कसाईखाना)

questions.question: The superior of a monastery
questions.solution: Abbot is the head of an abbey or monastery. (मठ का प्रधान)

questions.question: To increase the speed
questions.solution: Accelerate means to move faster or gain speed. (गति बढ़ाना)

questions.question: The school or college in which one has been educated
questions.solution: 'Alma Mater' refers to the school, college, or university that one formerly attended.

questions.question: To reduce to a shorter form intended to stand for the whole
questions.solution: Abbreviation is a shortened form of a word or phrase. (शब्दों का संक्षिप्त रूप)

questions.question: An animal that can live both on land and in water:
questions.solution: Amphibians are cold-blooded animals like frogs. Hindi: वे जीव जो जल और थल दोनों पर रह सकते हैं (उभयचर)।

questions.question: Giving cause for legal action
questions.solution: Actionable refers to something that gives reason for a lawsuit. / Actionable वह है जिस पर कानूनी कार्रवाई की जा सके।

questions.question: Very attractive and easy to feel love for
questions.solution: Adorable means inspiring great affection or delight. / Adorable का अर्थ बहुत प्यारा और आकर्षक होता है।

questions.question: To make something bad or unsatisfactory (like a situation) better:
questions.solution: Ameliorate means to improve a bad situation. Hindi: किसी खराब स्थिति को बेहतर बनाना (सुधारना)।

questions.question: Words that begin with the same letter, syllable or sound // Repetition of an initial sound in two or more words of a line
questions.solution: 'Alliteration' is the occurrence of the same letter or sound at the beginning of adjacent or closely connected words.

questions.question: The money paid to former wife, husband or partner when the marriage is ended
questions.solution: 'Alimony' is the legal obligation to provide financial support to a spouse after separation. 'Altar' is a table for offerings, 'Allegory' is a symbolic story, and 'Ambiguous' means having double meaning.

questions.question: Deviation from the right course
questions.solution: Aberration means a departure from what is normal or expected. (असामान्यता या पथ-विचलन)

questions.question: An extremely beautiful young man
questions.solution: Adonis is used to describe a young man of great physical beauty. / Adonis का उपयोग बहुत सुंदर युवक के लिए किया जाता है।

questions.question: To walk or move at a slow, relaxed pace, or to walk aimlessly:
questions.solution: Amble means to walk in a slow, relaxed way. Hindi: धीरे-धीरे या बिना किसी खास उद्देश्य के टहलना।

questions.question: A detailed examination of something complex:
questions.solution: Analysis is the process of breaking a complex topic into smaller parts to understand it. Hindi: किसी जटिल चीज़ का विस्तृत परीक्षण या विश्लेषण।

questions.question: A person who is friendly and good-natured:
questions.solution: Amicable refers to being friendly and peaceable. Hindi: मैत्रीपूर्ण और मिलनसार स्वभाव वाला व्यक्ति।

questions.question: A person belonging to a foreign country / different from what you are used to / A fictional being from another world
questions.solution: 'Alien' refers to someone from a foreign country or a different world. 'Alumnus' is a former student, 'Altruist' is a charitable person, and 'Ambassador' is a diplomatic representative.

questions.question: One who has the qualities of both shyness and openness at the same time:
questions.solution: An ambivert is a person whose personality has a balance of extrovert and introvert features. Hindi: वह व्यक्ति जिसमें अंतर्मुखी और बहिर्मुखी दोनों गुण हों।

questions.question: The scientific study of sound
questions.solution: Acoustics is the branch of physics concerned with the properties of sound. (ध्वनि विज्ञान)

questions.question: A partial or total loss of memory:
questions.solution: Amnesia is a medical condition where one loses memory. Hindi: याददाश्त का पूरी तरह या आंशिक रूप से चला जाना।

questions.question: A person who supports or speaks in favour of something
questions.solution: An Advocate is a person who supports a cause. / Advocate वह व्यक्ति है जो किसी पक्ष का समर्थन करता है।

questions.question: One who is not sure about God's existence
questions.solution: An Agnostic is unsure if God exists. / Agnostic वह है जो ईश्वर के अस्तित्व पर संदेह करता है।

questions.question: Able to use the left hand and right hand equally well
questions.solution: 'Ambidextrous' refers to a person who is able to use the right and left hands with equal ease.

questions.question: A feeling of strong dislike or hostility:
questions.solution: Animosity is a strong feeling of anger or lack of friendship. Hindi: गहरी दुश्मनी या शत्रुता की भावना।

questions.question: To do something // to behave in a particular way // to perform a part in a play/film/function
questions.solution: To Act means to perform a function or a role. / Act का अर्थ कार्य करना या अभिनय करना होता है।

questions.question: Capable of being understood in either of two or more possible senses, and therefore not definite
questions.solution: 'Ambiguous' means open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning.

questions.question: To shorten a piece of writing without losing the sense
questions.solution: Abridge means to shorten a book or text while maintaining the core meaning. (संक्षिप्त करना)

questions.question: Acting or done in a friendly and peaceable manner:
questions.solution: Amicably is the adverb form of amicable. Hindi: दोस्ताना और शांतिपूर्ण तरीके से।

questions.question: Formal forgiveness of a person's sins
questions.solution: Absolution is a formal release from guilt or sin. (पाप-मुक्ति या क्षमादान)

questions.question: The act of washing oneself
questions.solution: Ablution is the act of washing or cleansing, often for religious purposes. (शुद्धि स्नान या धार्मिक स्नान)

questions.question: A short, interesting or amusing story about a real person or an event:
questions.solution: An anecdote is a short account of a real incident. Hindi: किसी व्यक्ति या घटना के बारे में एक छोटा और रोचक किस्सा।

questions.question: A person who is physically dependent on a substance/harmful drugs
questions.solution: An Addict is someone enslaved to a habit or drug. / Addict वह व्यक्ति है जिसे किसी चीज़ की बुरी लत हो।

questions.question: An official pardon or the formal act of liberating someone (especially for political offenses):
questions.solution: Amnesty is a general pardon granted by a government. Hindi: राजनैतिक अपराधियों को दी जाने वाली औपचारिक माफी (राजक्षमा)।

questions.question: A blank book for keeping a collection of photographs, stamps or pictures
questions.solution: An Album is a book for collections. / Album वह किताब है जिसमें चित्र या टिकट रखे जाते हैं।

questions.question: A publication containing astronomical or meteorological annual calendar that contains important dates and time
questions.solution: 'Almanac' is an annual publication listing a set of events forthcoming in the next year (weather, sunrises, etc.).

questions.question: Not following any moral rules and not caring about right or wrong:
questions.solution: Amoral means lacking a moral sense; unconcerned with the rightness or wrongness of something. Hindi: नैतिक नियमों की परवाह न करने वाला (नीतिहीन)।

questions.question: The branch of science concerned with the bodily structure of humans and animals:
questions.solution: Anatomy studies the physical structure of living organisms. Hindi: शरीर रचना विज्ञान।

questions.question: Sharp, bitter, or harsh in temper, language, etc.
questions.solution: Acerbic refers to a sharp or biting way of speaking or acting. (कड़वा, तीखा या सख्त)

questions.question: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty
questions.solution: Aesthetic refers to the appreciation of beauty. / Aesthetic का संबंध सुंदरता और कला की समझ से है।

questions.question: To decide and state officially in court that somebody is not guilty of a crime
questions.solution: Acquit means to formally declare someone is not guilty. / Acquit का अर्थ है किसी को निर्दोष घोषित करना।

questions.question: Someone who is readily reacting to suggestions and willing to be guided or controlled:
questions.solution: Amenable means willing to follow advice or suggestions. Hindi: सुझावों को मानने वाला या आसानी से वश में आने वाला।

questions.question: A list of items to be discussed at a meeting
questions.solution: An Agenda is a schedule of matters to be dealt with. / Agenda वह सूची है जिस पर बैठक में चर्चा होनी है।

questions.question: The ability to make good judgments and take quick decisions // Sharpness and accuracy of judgement
questions.solution: Acumen is keen insight or shrewdness. / Acumen का अर्थ कुशाग्र बुद्धि या सही परख होना है।

questions.question: A person who helps another to commit a crime or to do something morally wrong
questions.solution: Accomplice is a partner in crime. (अपराध में साथ देने वाला सहभागी)

questions.question: To give up one's authority or throne
questions.solution: Abdicate means to formally give up a high office or throne. (स्वेच्छा से पद या सिंहासन त्यागना)

questions.question: Fear of riding in a car
questions.solution: 'Amaxophobia' is the persistent and intense fear of being a passenger in a car or other moving vehicle.

questions.question: An entertainer who performs difficult physical feats
questions.solution: An Acrobat is a performer of gymnastic feats. / Acrobat वह कलाकार है जो कठिन शारीरिक करतब दिखाता है।

questions.question: Growing/existing/living in air
questions.solution: Aerial means occurring in or existing in the air. / Aerial का अर्थ हवाई या हवा में रहने वाला है।

questions.question: Belonging to the very distant past:
questions.solution: Ancient means something from a very long time ago. Hindi: बहुत पुराने समय या प्राचीन काल का।

questions.question: A person who believes that laws and governments are not necessary:
questions.solution: An anarchist wants to bring a state of lawlessness. Hindi: वह जो शासन या सरकार को न माने (अराजकतावादी)।

questions.question: Extreme mental or physical suffering
questions.solution: Agony is the state of being in great pain. / Agony का अर्थ अत्यधिक पीड़ा या कष्ट होता है।

questions.question: The height above sea level
questions.solution: 'Altitude' is the vertical distance of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

questions.question: Act of giving up (renouncing) the throne
questions.solution: Abdication is the formal act of renouncing the throne. (पद त्याग या राजत्याग)

questions.question: Believe in and follow the practices of
questions.solution: To Adhere means to follow or stick to a belief or rule. / Adhere का अर्थ किसी नियम या विश्वास का पालन करना है।

questions.question: A person or behavior that is like a weak old woman:
questions.solution: Anile refers to someone showing the physical or mental decline associated with old women. Hindi: एक कमजोर बूढ़ी महिला की तरह।

questions.question: Make impure by adding inferior substances
questions.solution: To Adulterate is to make something impure. / Adulterate का अर्थ किसी चीज़ में मिलावट करना है।

questions.question: A situation in a country or organization in which there is no government, order, or control:
questions.solution: Anarchy is a state of disorder due to absence of authority. Hindi: देश में सरकार या कानून व्यवस्था का न होना (अराजकता)।

questions.question: Someone who makes charitable donations intended to the welfare of other people
questions.solution: 'Altruist' is a person unselfishly concerned for or devoted to the welfare of others.

questions.question: Always ready to attack or quarrel // One who is hostile and violent
questions.solution: Aggressive describes someone ready to fight. / Aggressive का अर्थ आक्रामक या झगड़ालू होता है।

questions.question: Instrument that measures the altitude of the land surface
questions.solution: 'Altimeter' is an instrument used in aircraft to measure its altitude above a fixed level.

questions.question: A shortened version of a larger work
questions.solution: Abridgement is the result of shortening a piece of writing. (संक्षेपण या सारांश)

questions.question: The original inhabitants/natives of a country
questions.solution: Aborigines are the people who have lived in a country from the beginning. (किसी देश के मूल निवासी)

questions.question: Study of chemistry in a medieval fashion
questions.solution: Alchemy was the medieval forerunner of chemistry. / Alchemy प्राचीन या मध्यकालीन रसायन विद्या है।

questions.question: A medical specialist who administers drugs for relieving pain during surgery:
questions.solution: An anesthetist is a doctor who gives anesthesia to patients. Hindi: वह डॉक्टर जो ऑपरेशन के दौरान दर्द कम करने के लिए बेहोशी की दवा देता है।

questions.question: A table or flat surface where offerings are made to a deity
questions.solution: 'Altar' is a holy table in a church or temple where religious ceremonies take place.

questions.question: Fear of pain
questions.solution: Algophobia is the extreme or irrational fear of experiencing pain. / Algophobia शारीरिक दर्द महसूस होने का एक असामान्य या अत्यधिक डर है।

questions.question: A person who presents a radio or television programme:
questions.solution: An anchor is the host of a broadcast show. Hindi: रेडियो या टीवी कार्यक्रम का संचालन करने वाला।

questions.question: A story, play, picture, etc. in which each character/event is a symbol representing an idea/a quality
questions.solution: 'Allegory' uses symbols to convey a deeper moral or political meaning. 'Alliteration' is the repetition of sounds, 'Alpinism' is mountain climbing, and 'Alluvium' is soil deposited by water.

questions.question: An abbreviation formed from the initial letters of other words and pronounced as a word
questions.solution: An Acronym is a pronounceable word like NASA. / Acronym वह शब्द है जो शब्दों के पहले अक्षरों से बनता है।

questions.question: Fear of great heights
questions.solution: Acrophobia is the clinical fear of heights. / Acrophobia का अर्थ ऊँचाई से लगने वाला डर है।

questions.question: Be harmonious or consistent with
questions.solution: Accord means to be in agreement or harmony with something. (सहमति या सामंजस्य)

questions.question: Any award, honour or laudatory notice
questions.solution: Accolade is an award or privilege granted as a special honour. (सम्मान या पुरस्कार)

questions.question: A former student of a school, college or university
questions.solution: 'Alumnus' refers to a graduate or former student of a particular school, college, or university.

questions.question: Make a machine active or operative
questions.solution: To Activate means to trigger or start a process. / Activate का अर्थ किसी चीज़ को सक्रिय या चालू करना है।

questions.question: A departure from what is normal, common, or expected:
questions.solution: Anomaly is something that deviates from the standard or normal rule. Hindi: सामान्य नियम या स्थिति से भटकाव या विसंगति।

questions.question: Become less intense or widespread
questions.solution: Abate refers to something becoming less intense or severe. (तीव्रता में कमी आना या शांत होना)

questions.question: The date on which an event happened in some previous year:
questions.solution: Anniversary is a date that is remembered because a special event happened on it. Hindi: वह तारीख जिस पर पिछले किसी वर्ष में कोई घटना घटी थी (वर्षगांठ)।

questions.question: A fixed sum of money paid to someone each year, typically for the rest of their life:
questions.solution: Annuity is a fixed amount of money paid at regular intervals. Hindi: सालाना दी जाने वाली एक निश्चित राशि (वार्षिकी)।

questions.question: Wildly unreasonable, illogical or ridiculous
questions.solution: Absurd means something that is completely illogical or senseless. (बेहूदा या बेतुका)

questions.question: One who plays for pleasure rather than as a profession // A person who is neither well experienced nor professional
questions.solution: 'Amateur' is a person who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid rather than a professional basis.

questions.question: A person whose profession is to keep accounts
questions.solution: An accountant manages financial records and books. (मुनीम या लेखाकार)

questions.question: Something written or done by a person whose name is not known or made public:
questions.solution: Anonymous means having an unknown or unacknowledged name/author. Hindi: जिसका नाम ज्ञात न हो (गुमनाम)।

questions.question: A substance for killing algae
questions.solution: Algaecide is a chemical used to kill and prevent the growth of algae. / Algaecide एक ऐसा रसायन है जिसका उपयोग शैवाल (algae) को मारने और उनकी वृद्धि को रोकने के लिए किया जाता है।

questions.question: The character and atmosphere of a place
questions.solution: 'Ambience' is the character and atmosphere of a place (the mood or feeling of a specific environment).

questions.question: Soil deposited by flowing water
questions.solution: 'Alluvium' is a deposit of clay, silt, and sand left by flowing floodwater in a river valley or delta.

questions.question: A diplomatic representative in another country
questions.solution: 'Ambassador' is an accredited diplomat sent by a country as its official representative to a foreign country.

questions.question: To refuse or deny oneself
questions.solution: Abnegate means to renounce or reject something desired. (त्यागना या अस्वीकार करना)

questions.question: Willing to take risks and try new ideas
questions.solution: An Adventurous person seeks out new and risky experiences. / Adventurous वह है जो जोखिम उठाने के लिए तैयार रहे।

questions.question: To go away suddenly and secretly in order to escape from somewhere
questions.solution: Abscond means to leave secretly, typically to avoid detection or arrest. (फरार हो जाना)

questions.question: To increase the importance, position or wealth
questions.solution: To Aggrandize is to increase one's power or status. / Aggrandize का अर्थ शक्ति या पद बढ़ाना है।

questions.question: To destroy something completely so that nothing remains:
questions.solution: Annihilate means to wipe out or destroy utterly. Hindi: पूरी तरह से नष्ट कर देना या मिटा देना।

questions.question: Existing in a land from the earliest times or before the arrival of colonists
questions.solution: Aboriginal means relating to the original inhabitants of a place. (आदिम या मूल निवासी से संबंधित)

questions.question: Cancel or do away with (a law or agreement)
questions.solution: Abrogate means to repeal or do away with a formal agreement or law. (कानून या समझौते को रद्द करना)

questions.question: The period between the beginning of puberty and adulthood
questions.solution: Adolescence is the transitional stage from childhood to adulthood. / Adolescence किशोरावस्था को कहते हैं।

questions.question: A self-governing country or region is known as having:
questions.solution: Autonomy (न.) का अर्थ है स्वशासन या स्वायत्तता।

questions.question: A building where an audience sits to watch a performance or hear a lecture:
questions.solution: Auditorium (न.) का अर्थ है सभागार या प्रेक्षागृह जहाँ दर्शक बैठते हैं।

questions.question: A military structure where arms and ammunition and other military equipment are stored
questions.solution: 'Arsenal' is a place where weapons and military equipment are stored or made. (शस्त्रागार)

questions.question: A place that provides refuge or a hospital where people who are mentally ill are cared for:
questions.solution: Asylum (न.) का अर्थ है शरणस्थल या मानसिक चिकित्सालय।

questions.question: The outer protective layer of a tree trunk:
questions.solution: Bark (न.) का अर्थ है पेड़ की छाल।

questions.question: A poem that tells a story and has a regular rhythm and rhyme scheme:
questions.solution: Ballad (न.) का अर्थ है गाथा-गीत या लोक-गीत जो कहानी सुनाता है।

questions.question: A place given to soldiers to live in:
questions.solution: Barracks (न.) का अर्थ है सैनिकों के रहने का स्थान (छावनी)।

questions.question: A medicine to nullify the effect of poison or another medicine
questions.solution: 'Antidote' is a medicine taken or given to counteract a particular poison.

questions.question: Something that is made or done in the traditional or original way, or something that is genuine:
questions.solution: Authentic (वि.) का अर्थ है विश्वसनीय, असली या प्रामाणिक।

questions.question: Fear of fire
questions.solution: 'Arsonphobia' (also known as Pyrophobia) is the irrational fear of fire. (आग से डर)

questions.question: Nations that do not trust each other or look upon each other with suspicion are said to look:
questions.solution: Askance (वि.) का अर्थ है संदेह की दृष्टि से देखना (with suspicion/distrust).

questions.question: A large bundle bound for storage or transport:
questions.solution: Bale (न.) का अर्थ है गांठ (जैसे कपास या घास की बड़ी पोटली)।

questions.question: A large body of water with many islands
questions.solution: 'Archipelago' is a group or chain of islands clustered together in a sea or ocean. (द्वीपसमूह)

questions.question: One who makes an official examination of accounts or financial records:
questions.solution: Auditor (न.) वह व्यक्ति है जो खातों की जाँच करता है (लेखा परीक्षक)।

questions.question: Jokes and funny remarks exchanged amongst friends:
questions.solution: Banter (न.) का अर्थ है मित्रों के बीच होने वाला मज़ाक या हंसी-ठिठोली।

questions.question: To revel in and make the most of something pleasing (like sunlight):
questions.solution: Bask (वि.) का अर्थ है आनंद लेना या धूप सेंकना।

questions.question: The ability to communicate effectively and express oneself clearly in writing and speaking is known as:
questions.solution: Articulation (न.) का अर्थ है स्पष्ट उच्चारण या अभिव्यक्ति की शक्ति।

questions.question: An official inspection of a company's or individual's accounts:
questions.solution: Audit (न.) का अर्थ है खातों की आधिकारिक जाँच या लेखा परीक्षा।

questions.question: A person engaged in or trained for spaceflight:
questions.solution: Astronaut (न.) का अर्थ है अंतरिक्ष यात्री।

questions.question: To agree to a request, an idea, or a suggestion:
questions.solution: Assent (वि.) का अर्थ है किसी सुझाव या प्रस्ताव पर सहमति देना।

questions.question: An official examination of a dead body by a doctor to discover the cause of death:
questions.solution: Autopsy (न.) का अर्थ है शव-परीक्षा (Post-mortem)।

questions.question: A government by the nobles / government by person of highest social order
questions.solution: 'Aristocracy' is a form of government in which power is held by the nobility or highest social class. (शिष्टजन/कुलीनतंत्र)

questions.question: A rule or principle that most people believe to be true:
questions.solution: Axiom (न.) का अर्थ है स्वयं सिद्ध सत्य या सूक्ति।

questions.question: Senseless talk or writing is often referred to as:
questions.solution: Balderdash (न.) का अर्थ है बकवास या अर्थहीन बात।

questions.question: Being afraid of water or being near water
questions.solution: 'Aquaphobia' is an abnormal and persistent fear of water. (पानी से डर)

questions.question: A mass of snow, ice, and rocks falling rapidly down a mountainside:
questions.solution: Avalanche (न.) का अर्थ है हिमस्खलन।

questions.question: Using an idea, term, or name frequently in casual talk:
questions.solution: Bandying (वि.) का अर्थ है किसी शब्द या विचार का बार-बार या लापरवाही से प्रयोग करना।

questions.question: A place where bees are kept
questions.solution: 'Apiary' is a place where bees are kept; a collection of beehives.

questions.question: A person who renounces a religious or political belief or principle
questions.solution: 'Apostate' is a person who has abandoned their religious or political beliefs. (धर्मत्यागी)

questions.question: A policy that segregates people on the basis of race // Policy of racial discrimination
questions.solution: 'Apartheid' was a policy or system of segregation or discrimination on grounds of race.

questions.question: A collection of poems, stories, etc. that have been written by different people and published together in a book
questions.solution: 'Anthology' is a published collection of poems or other pieces of writing.

questions.question: Words which are opposite in meaning
questions.solution: 'Antonym' is a word opposite in meaning to another (e.g. bad and good).

questions.question: A pioneer of a reform movement
questions.solution: 'Apostle' refers to a vigorous and pioneering advocate or leader of a reform movement. (सुधार आंदोलन का अगुआ/प्रेरित)

questions.question: A wooden drum in which beer or oil is stored:
questions.solution: Barrel (न.) का अर्थ है पीपा या लकड़ी का बड़ा ढोल।

questions.question: The place where public, government or historical records are kept
questions.solution: 'Archive' is a collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people. (अभिलेखागार)

questions.question: Something of monstrous size or power:
questions.solution: Behemoth (न.) का अर्थ है विशालकाय जीव या अत्यंत शक्तिशाली वस्तु।

questions.question: Obsessive desire to lose weight by refusing to eat
questions.solution: 'Anorexia' is an eating disorder characterized by an abnormally low body weight and an intense fear of gaining weight.

questions.question: A person who is severe or very strict in his manner and lifestyle:
questions.solution: Austere (वि.) का अर्थ है कठोर, सादा या संयमी जीवन जीने वाला।

questions.question: One who tells the future by studying the positions of the stars:
questions.solution: Astrologer (न.) वह है जो सितारों को देखकर भविष्य बताता है (ज्योतिषी)।

questions.question: Be appropriate or applicable
questions.solution: 'Appertain' means to be appropriate or applicable to something. (संबद्ध होना/लागू होना)

questions.question: An instrument used for measuring atmospheric pressure:
questions.solution: Barometer (न.) वायुदाबमापी यंत्र है।

questions.question: To rise in value
questions.solution: 'Appreciate' means to increase in monetary value over time. (मूल्य बढ़ना)

questions.question: The feeling of not being interested in or enthusiastic
questions.solution: 'Apathy' is the noun form representing lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern.

questions.question: The exact opposite
questions.solution: 'Antithesis' refers to a person or thing that is the direct opposite of someone or something else.

questions.question: A group of guns or missile launchers operated together at one place:
questions.solution: Battery (न.) का अर्थ है तोपों या मिसाइल लॉन्चरों का समूह।

questions.question: The quality of being politely firm and demanding:
questions.solution: Assertive (वि.) का अर्थ है अपनी बात को दृढ़ता और आत्मविश्वास से कहना।

questions.question: Something that can be heard clearly:
questions.solution: Audible (वि.) का अर्थ है जो स्पष्ट सुनाई दे सके (श्रव्य)।

questions.question: Estimation of a thing’s worth
questions.solution: 'Appraisal' is the act of assessing or estimating something or someone's value. (मूल्यांकन)

questions.question: The life history of a person written by himself:
questions.solution: Autobiography (न.) का अर्थ है आत्मकथा, जो व्यक्ति स्वयं लिखता है।

questions.question: A person who is chosen to settle a disagreement // A person appointed by two parties to resolve a dispute
questions.solution: 'Arbitrator' is an independent person or body officially appointed to settle a dispute. (मध्यस्थ/पंच)

questions.question: Keen interest or enthusiasm for something is called:
questions.solution: Avidity (न.) का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ के प्रति तीव्र उत्साह या लालसा।

questions.question: The study of human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites
questions.solution: 'Archaeology' is the scientific study of material remains (such as tools, pottery, jewelry, stone walls, and monuments) of past human life and activities. (पुरातत्व विज्ञान)

questions.question: The scientific study of celestial bodies like the sun, moon, stars, and planets:
questions.solution: Astronomy (न.) खगोल विज्ञान है, जो आकाशीय पिंडों का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन करता है।

questions.question: A person who is fond of fighting:
questions.solution: Bellicose (वि.) का अर्थ है लड़ाकू या युद्धप्रिय।

questions.question: An insatiable or extreme desire for wealth:
questions.solution: Avarice (न.) का अर्थ है धन का अत्यधिक लालच (लोभ)।

questions.question: A place where bread and cakes are made and sold:
questions.solution: Bakery (न.) वह स्थान है जहाँ ब्रेड और केक बनाए जाते हैं।

questions.question: One who studies/deals antique things
questions.solution: 'Antiquarian' is a person who studies or collects antiques or antiquities.

questions.question: Strong dislike between two persons // A deep-seated feeling of aversion
questions.solution: 'Antipathy' refers to a deep-seated feeling of dislike or aversion.

questions.question: Suitable for growing crops
questions.solution: 'Arable' land is land capable of being ploughed and used to grow crops. (कृषि योग्य)

questions.question: One who helps people by giving them money or other aid is called a:
questions.solution: Benefactor (न.) वह व्यक्ति है जो दूसरों की आर्थिक या अन्य सहायता करता है (धर्मोपकारी)।

questions.question: An action of making amends for a wrong or injury:
questions.solution: Atonement (न.) का अर्थ है प्रायश्चित या क्षतिपूर्ति करना।

questions.question: A man who remains unmarried:
questions.solution: Bachelor (न.) का अर्थ है कुंवारा व्यक्ति।

questions.question: Animals and plants growing or living in, or near water
questions.solution: 'Aquatic' refers to organisms living or growing in water. (जलीय)

questions.question: To keep away from someone or something:
questions.solution: Avoid (वि.) का अर्थ है दूर रहना या टालना।

questions.question: A group, especially in the arts, regarded as being the most experimental or innovative:
questions.solution: Avant-Garde (वि./न.) का अर्थ है कला के क्षेत्र में नए प्रयोग करने वाला अग्रणी समूह।

questions.question: The act of killing birds is known as:
questions.solution: Avicide (न.) का अर्थ है पक्षियों की हत्या।

questions.question: No longer in use
questions.solution: 'Archaic' refers to something that is very old or old-fashioned and no longer in common use. (प्राचीन/अप्रचलित)

questions.question: The deep, loud sound made by a crocodile or a large animal:
questions.solution: Bellow (वि.) का अर्थ है गरजना या जोर से चिल्लाना (जैसे मगरमच्छ की आवाज़)।

questions.question: A person who physically attacks another is called an:
questions.solution: Assailant (न.) का अर्थ है हमलावर या आक्रमणकारी।

questions.question: A person who kills somebody, especially for political reasons, is an:
questions.solution: Assassin (न.) वह व्यक्ति है जो राजनीतिक कारणों से किसी की हत्या करता है।

questions.question: A ruler who has complete power over a country is called:
questions.solution: Autocrat (न.) का अर्थ है तानाशाह या एकछत्र शासक जिसके पास पूर्ण शक्ति होती है।

questions.question: A person who formally requests something, especially a job
questions.solution: 'Applicant' is a person who makes a formal application for something, especially a job. (आवेदक)

questions.question: To attribute a cause or characteristic to something is to:
questions.solution: Ascribe (वि.) का अर्थ है किसी कारण या विशेषता का श्रेय देना (to attribute).

questions.question: Deliberately and maliciously set something (buildings usually) on fire
questions.solution: 'Arson' is the criminal act of deliberately setting fire to property. (आगजनी)

questions.question: One who denies oneself ordinary bodily pleasures and lives a simple, strict life:
questions.solution: Ascetic (न.) का अर्थ है तपस्वी या आत्मसंयमी, जो शारीरिक सुखों का त्याग करता है।

questions.question: One who is good at expressing ideas or feelings clearly in words is called:
questions.solution: Articulate का अर्थ होता है स्पष्ट रूप से बोलने में कुशल। Having the ability to speak fluently and coherently.

questions.question: A system of government of a country in which one person has complete power:
questions.solution: Autocracy (न.) का अर्थ है एकतंत्र या तानाशाही, जहाँ शासन की पूरी शक्ति एक ही व्यक्ति के पास होती है।

questions.question: A glass tank where fish and water plants are kept
questions.solution: 'Aquarium' is a transparent tank of water in which fish and other water creatures and plants are kept. (मछलीघर)

questions.question: Loss of speech due to medical problem
questions.solution: 'Aphasia' is a condition that robs you of the ability to communicate, often caused by a stroke or head injury.

questions.question: One who doesn’t believe in the existence of God:
questions.solution: Atheist (न.) वह व्यक्ति है जो ईश्वर के अस्तित्व में विश्वास नहीं करता (नास्तिक)।

questions.question: One who is unable to pay his debts:
questions.solution: Bankrupt (न./वि.) का अर्थ है दिवालिया, जो अपना कर्ज चुकाने में असमर्थ हो।

questions.question: A person who works for an expert to learn a trade
questions.solution: 'Apprentice' is a person who is learning a trade from a skilled employer. (शिक्षु/चेला)

questions.question: The study of human race, especially of its origin, development, customs and beliefs
questions.solution: 'Anthropology' is the scientific study of humanity, concerned with human behavior, human biology, cultures, societies, and linguistics.

questions.question: A set of rooms forming one residence in a building
questions.solution: 'Apartment' is a suite of rooms forming one residence, typically in a building containing others.

questions.question: A place where fights take place // A place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict
questions.solution: 'Arena' is a level area surrounded by seating, in which sports, entertainments, and other public events are held. (अखाड़ा/रंगभूमि)

questions.question: A place for keeping birds in a confined space:
questions.solution: Aviary (न.) का अर्थ है पक्षीशाला, जहाँ पक्षियों को रखा जाता है।

questions.question: A criminal who illegally sets fire to property
questions.solution: 'Arsonist' is a person who commits the crime of arson (deliberately setting fire to property). (आगजनी करने वाला अपराधी)

questions.question: The science of foretelling events by mapping stars:
questions.solution: Astrology (न.) वह विज्ञान या विद्या है जिसमें सितारों के माध्यम से भविष्य की भविष्यवाणी की जाती है।

questions.question: A person who has an extreme desire for wealth:
questions.solution: Avaricious (वि.) का अर्थ है लालची या लोभी व्यक्ति।

questions.question: Look forward to
questions.solution: 'Anticipate' means to expect or predict a future event and prepare for it.

questions.question: One who studies human antiquities
questions.solution: 'Archaeologist' is a person who studies human history through the excavation of sites. (पुरातात्विक)

questions.question: One who studies the evolution of mankind
questions.solution: 'Anthropologist' is an expert in or student of anthropology, the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

questions.question: A man having no hair on the scalp:
questions.solution: Bald (वि.) का अर्थ है गंजा।

questions.question: To express regret for something that one has done wrong
questions.solution: 'Apologize' means to express regret for something one has done wrong.

questions.question: Zeal; burning enthusiasm; passion
questions.solution: 'Ardor' means great enthusiasm, passion, or love. (उत्साह/जोश)

questions.question: Showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern
questions.solution: 'Apathetic' is an adjective describing someone showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern.

questions.question: Causing shock or dismay
questions.solution: 'Appalling' describes something that is very bad or shocking. (भयावह/डरावना)

questions.question: Based on chance rather than on reason or a plan
questions.solution: 'Arbitrary' means based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system. (मनमाना/तर्कहीन)

questions.question: A person who practices one of the fine arts, such as painting or sculpture:
questions.solution: Artist (न.) वह व्यक्ति है जो ललित कलाओं (fine arts) का अभ्यास करता है।

questions.question: The state of having rejected your religious beliefs or your political party or a cause
questions.solution: 'Apostasy' is the abandonment or renunciation of a religious or political belief. (धर्मत्याग/स्वधर्मत्याग)

questions.question: Preoccupation with the acquisition and possession of books
questions.solution: 'Bibliomania' is an excessive fondness for acquiring and possessing books. (किताबों का पागलपन)

questions.question: A time when enemies agree to stop fighting
questions.solution: 'Ceasefire' is a temporary suspension of fighting; a truce. (युद्धविराम)

questions.question: A sum of money added to a person’s wages as a reward for good performance
questions.solution: 'Bonus' is an extra amount of money that is added to a payment or wages as a reward. (पारितोषिक/अधिलाभांश)

questions.question: A person who enters a building illegally in order to steal
questions.solution: 'Burglar' is a person who commits theft by entering a building illegally. (सेंधमार/चोर)

questions.question: Song which is sung in a church by a group of singers
questions.solution: 'Carol' is a religious folk song or popular hymn, particularly one associated with Christmas. (ईसाई भजन/क्रिसमस के गीत)

questions.question: An event causing great and sudden damage or suffering
questions.solution: 'Catastrophe' is an event causing great and usually sudden damage or suffering; a disaster. (तबाही/आपदा)

questions.question: A collection of sticks
questions.solution: 'Bundle' is a collection of things or quantity of material tied or wrapped up together. (गठरी/गट्ठर)

questions.question: The art of beautiful handwriting
questions.solution: 'Calligraphy' is decorative handwriting or handwritten lettering. (सुलेखन कला)

questions.question: Hole excavated by an animal as dwelling
questions.solution: 'Burrow' is a hole or tunnel dug by a small animal, especially a rabbit, as a dwelling. (बिल/मांद)

questions.question: Words uttered impiously about God // The act of speaking irreverently about sacred things
questions.solution: 'Blasphemy' is the action or offence of speaking sacrilegiously about God or sacred things. (ईश-निंदा)

questions.question: A narrow or busy section of road where the traffic often gets slower and stops
questions.solution: 'Bottleneck' is a situation or a place that causes delay in a process or system (like traffic). (बाधा/संकरा रास्ता)

questions.question: An avid book reader // One who reads a lot
questions.solution: 'Bookworm' is a person who enjoys reading very much and spends a lot of time doing it. (किताबी कीड़ा)

questions.question: Leather straps put around a horse’s head to control it
questions.solution: 'Bridle' is the headgear used to control a horse, consisting of buckled straps. (लगाम)

questions.question: That which makes it difficult to recognize the presence or real nature of something
questions.solution: 'Camouflage' is the use of materials or coloration for concealment. (छलावरण/छद्मावरण)

questions.question: A person of South African Dutch descent
questions.solution: 'Boer' refers to the descendants of the Dutch-speaking settlers of South Africa. (बोअर)

questions.question: Hard but easily broken // liable to break easily
questions.solution: 'Brittle' means hard but liable to break or shatter easily. (भंगुर/नाजुक)

questions.question: The scientific study of plants and their structure
questions.solution: 'Botany' is the scientific study of the physiology, structure, genetics, and ecology of plants. (वनस्पति विज्ञान)

questions.question: A doctor who specializes in the study or treatment of heart diseases
questions.solution: 'Cardiologist' is a doctor who specializes in the study or treatment of heart diseases. (हृदय रोग विशेषज्ञ)

questions.question: Completely lifeless and unresponsive
questions.solution: 'Cadaverous' means resembling a corpse in being very pale, thin, or bony. (शव जैसा/पीला और दुबला)

questions.question: An act of breaking or failing to observe a law
questions.solution: 'Breach' is an act of breaking or failing to observe a law, agreement, or code of conduct. (उल्लंघन/दरार)

questions.question: A shady place under trees
questions.solution: 'Bower' is a pleasant shady place under trees or climbing plants in a garden or wood. (कुंज/लता-मंडप)

questions.question: A group of things that have been hidden in some place
questions.solution: 'Cache' is a collection of items of the same type stored in a hidden or inaccessible place. (गुप्त भंडार)

questions.question: Causing great damage or suffering
questions.solution: 'Catastrophic' is the adjective form describing something involving or causing sudden great damage. (विनाशकारी)

questions.question: A local meeting of party members to select candidates, elect convention delegates, etc.
questions.solution: 'Caucus' is a meeting of the members of a particular political party to select candidates or decide policy. (दल की सभा/बैठक)

questions.question: A large single detached house with single or double story
questions.solution: 'Bungalow' is a low house having only one story or, in some cases, upper rooms set in the roof. (बंगला)

questions.question: Huge fire for celebration
questions.solution: 'Bonfire' is a large open-air fire used as part of a celebration. (होली की तरह जलाई जाने वाली आग/धूनी)

questions.question: One who is well-versed in the knowledge of plants // The scientific study of plants
questions.solution: 'Botanist' is an expert in or student of the scientific study of plants. (वनस्पतिशास्त्री)

questions.question: Belonging to middle class
questions.solution: 'Bourgeois' refers to the middle class, typically with reference to its perceived materialistic values. (मध्यमवर्गीय)

questions.question: A person who is a 100 years old or more
questions.solution: 'Centenarian' is a person who is a hundred or more years old. (सौ वर्ष का व्यक्ति)

questions.question: A person who loves or collects books
questions.solution: 'Bibliophile' is a person who collects or has a great love of books. (पुस्तकाप्रेमी)

questions.question: A floating container anchored to the sea bottom, used for directing ships and warning them of danger
questions.solution: 'Buoy' is an anchored float serving as a navigation mark. (लंगर डाल कर ठहराया हुआ बोया)

questions.question: One who does not follow the usual rules of social life // An unconventional style of living
questions.solution: 'Bohemian' is a person who has informal and unconventional social habits. (रूढ़िमुक्त/स्वेच्छाचारी)

questions.question: Love for dogs
questions.solution: 'Canophilia' is the love or fondness for dogs. (कुत्तों से प्रेम)

questions.question: Carry out a task clumsily or incompetently
questions.solution: 'Bungle' means to do something badly or without skill. (काम बिगाड़ देना/भूल करना)

questions.question: A large, deep pot used both in the oven and as a serving vessel
questions.solution: 'Casserole' is a large, deep dish used both in the oven and as a serving vessel. (एक गहरा बर्तन)

questions.question: A small shop that sells fashionable clothes
questions.solution: 'Boutique' is a small shop selling fashionable clothes or accessories. (बूटीक/वस्त्रालय)

questions.question: Rhythmic flow of sounds or words
questions.solution: 'Cadence' is a modulation or inflection of the voice or a rhythmic flow of sounds. (ताल/स्वर का उतार-चढ़ाव)

questions.question: A broad road bordered with trees
questions.solution: 'Boulevard' is a wide street in a town or city, typically one lined with trees. (मुख्य मार्ग/पेड़ों वाला चौड़ा रास्ता)

questions.question: An arrangement of flowers that is usually given as a present
questions.solution: 'Bouquet' is an attractively arranged bunch of flowers, especially one presented as a gift. (गुलदस्ता)

questions.question: A person who is intolerant towards those holding different opinions // One who has narrow and prejudiced religious views
questions.solution: 'Bigot' is a person who is obstinately or unreasonably attached to a belief or opinion. (कट्टर/धर्मांध)

questions.question: A picture of a person or a thing drawn in such a highly exaggerated manner as to cause laughter
questions.solution: 'Caricature' is a picture or description of a person in which certain characteristics are exaggerated for comic effect. (व्यंग्य-चित्र)

questions.question: Anything tending to move away from centre
questions.solution: 'Centrifugal' refers to a force that acts outwards on a body moving around a centre. (केंद्रप्रसारक/केन्द्रत्यागी)

questions.question: A person who gains as a result of something // A person who derives advantage from something
questions.solution: 'Beneficiary' is the person who receives help or advantage from something like a will or insurance. (लाभार्थी)

questions.question: An itemized summary of estimated expenses for a given period along with proposals for financing them
questions.solution: 'Budgeting' is the process of creating a plan to spend your money. (बजट बनाना)

questions.question: The war resulted in ruthless killing of many people
questions.solution: 'Carnage' is the killing of a large number of people. (नरसंहार/हत्याकांड)

questions.question: A person who eats human flesh
questions.solution: 'Cannibal' is a person who eats the flesh of other human beings. (नरभक्षी)

questions.question: Capable of being decomposed by biological agents, especially bacteria
questions.solution: 'Biodegradable' refers to substances capable of being decomposed by bacteria or other living organisms. (जैव-निम्नीकरणीय)

questions.question: Underground place for storing wine or other provisions
questions.solution: 'Cellar' is a room below ground level in a house, typically used for storing wine or coal. (तहखाना)

questions.question: A person who draws or makes maps
questions.solution: 'Cartographer' is a person who creates or produces maps. (मानचित्रकार)

questions.question: Scientific study of living organisms
questions.solution: 'Biology' is the natural science that studies life and living organisms. (जीव विज्ञान)

questions.question: A thing which happens every two years
questions.solution: 'Biennial' describes something that happens once every two years. (द्विवार्षिक)

questions.question: The sound of a crow
questions.solution: 'Caw' is the harsh cry of a crow or similar bird. (काँव-काँव)

questions.question: A group of girls/boys/birds etc.
questions.solution: 'Bevy' is used to describe a large group of people or things of a particular kind. (झुंड/टोली)

questions.question: Very strange or unusual
questions.solution: 'Bizarre' describes something that is very strange or unusual. (अजीब/विचित्र)

questions.question: The state of being unmarried by choice
questions.solution: 'Celibacy' is the state of abstaining from marriage and sexual relations. (ब्रह्मचर्य/अविवाहित जीवन)

questions.question: House or shelter of a gipsy // A group of people travelling together across a desert
questions.solution: 'Caravan' is a vehicle equipped for living in, or a group of people/animals traveling together. (काफिला/कारवां)

questions.question: A man devoid of kind feeling and sympathy
questions.solution: 'Callous' means showing or having an insensitive and cruel disregard for others. (कठोर/निर्दयी)

questions.question: Animals that eat meat
questions.solution: 'Carnivorous' refers to animals that feed on other animals/flesh. (मांसाहारी)

questions.question: The young of an animal cared for at one time // A family of young birds
questions.solution: 'Brood' is a family of young animals, especially birds, produced at one hatching or birth. (पक्षियों का झोंट/एक ही बार के बच्चे)

questions.question: Harsh or discordant sound // Loud confusing disagreeable sounds
questions.solution: 'Cacophony' is a harsh, discordant mixture of sounds. (कोलाहल/कटु स्वर)

questions.question: Dwarf varieties of trees and shrubs grown in pots
questions.solution: 'Bonsai' is the art of growing ornamental, artificially dwarfed trees or shrubs in pots. (बौने पौधे उगाने की कला)

questions.question: Place where cows are sheltered
questions.solution: 'Byre' is a dialect word for a cowshed. (गौशाला)

questions.question: Affecting or relating to cows or cattle
questions.solution: 'Bovine' relates to or affects cattle (cows/oxen). (गो-जातीय)

questions.question: The sound made by bees
questions.solution: 'Buzz' is a low, continuous humming or murmuring sound, made by or similar to that made by an insect. (भिनभिनाहट)

questions.question: A person who has money especially invested in business
questions.solution: 'Capitalist' is a wealthy person who uses money to invest in trade and industry for profit. (पूंजीपति)

questions.question: The removal of tissue from the body of somebody who is ill and its examination in order to find out more about the disease
questions.solution: 'Biopsy' is an examination of tissue removed from a living body to discover the presence or cause of a disease. (जीवोति-जांच)

questions.question: Member of a band of robbers
questions.solution: 'Brigand' is a member of a gang that ambushes and robs people in forests or mountains. (डाकू/लुटेरा)

questions.question: A woman with dark brown hair
questions.solution: 'Brunette' refers to a woman or girl with dark brown hair. (सांवली/भूरे बालों वाली महिला)

questions.question: A large, deep, metal pot used for cooking over open fire
questions.solution: 'Cauldron' is a large metal pot with a lid and handle, used for cooking over an open fire. (कड़ाहा)

questions.question: A hunting weapon which comes back, used by Australian Aborigines
questions.solution: 'Boomerang' is a curved flat piece of wood that can be thrown so that it returns to the thrower. (बुमेरांग/एक हथियार जो फेंकने वाले के पास लौट आता है)

questions.question: One who is bad in spellings
questions.solution: 'Cacographer' is a person who is bad at spelling or has poor handwriting. (अशुद्ध लिखने वाला)

questions.question: A place where gambling games are played
questions.solution: 'Casino' is a public room or building where gambling games are played. (जुआघर)

questions.question: The 100th anniversary of an event
questions.solution: 'Centennial' relates to a hundredth anniversary. (सौवीं वर्षगाँठ)

questions.question: An amusing drawing about politics/events in the news
questions.solution: 'Cartoon' is a simple drawing showing the features of its subjects in a humorously exaggerated way. (व्यंग्य-चित्र/कार्टून)

questions.question: A person who can speak only two languages
questions.solution: 'Bilingual' refers to a person who is able to speak two languages fluently. (द्विभाषी)

questions.question: Soldiers who fight on horseback
questions.solution: 'Cavalry' refers to the part of an army that fights on horseback. (घुड़सवार सेना)

questions.question: A meal that is usually taken late in the morning that combines a late breakfast and an early lunch
questions.solution: 'Brunch' is a meal eaten in the late morning that is a combination of breakfast and lunch. (देर से किया गया नाश्ता/दोपहर का भोजन)

questions.question: The young one of a cow
questions.solution: 'Calf' is the young of a cow or certain other large mammals. (बछड़ा)

questions.question: A list of the books referred to in a scholarly work
questions.solution: 'Bibliography' is a list of books and articles consulted by an author. (ग्रंथसूची)

questions.question: Using high-sounding words but with little meaning
questions.solution: 'Bombastic' refers to language that is high-sounding but has little meaning; inflated. (शब्दों से आडंबरपूर्ण)

questions.question: The dead body of an animal
questions.solution: 'Carcass' is the dead body of an animal, especially one slaughtered and used for food. (पशु का शव)

questions.question: A person who is skilled at producing beautiful handwriting
questions.solution: 'Calligrapher' is a person who practices the art of beautiful handwriting. (सुलेखक)

questions.question: 200th anniversary
questions.solution: 'Bicentennial' is the two-hundredth anniversary of a significant event. (द्विशताब्दी)

questions.question: A fall of water from a great height
questions.solution: 'Cascade' is a small waterfall, typically one of several that fall in stages down a rocky slope. (झरना/जलप्रपात)

questions.question: The art or process of drawing or making maps
questions.solution: 'Cartography' is the science or practice of drawing maps. (मानचित्रकारी)

questions.question: Twice a month // Occurring every two months
questions.solution: 'Bimonthly' can mean twice a month or once every two months. (द्विमासिक)

questions.question: The sound made by sheep
questions.solution: 'Bleat' is the characteristic wavering cry made by a sheep, goat, or calf. (मिमियाना)

questions.question: The story of a person’s life written by somebody else
questions.solution: 'Biography' is an account of someone's life written by someone else. (जीवनी)

questions.question: A large burial ground
questions.solution: 'Cemetery' is a large burial ground, especially one not next to a church. (कब्रिस्तान)

questions.question: Deprived of or lacking of something
questions.solution: 'Bereft' means lacking something needed, wanted, or expected. (वंचित/विहीन)

questions.question: Any soft drink except water
questions.solution: 'Beverage' is a drink of any type (other than water). (पेय पदार्थ)

questions.question: Gold and silver before using for manufacturing ornaments
questions.solution: 'Bullion' is gold or silver in bulk before coining, or valued by weight. (सोने-चांदी की ईंटें/बिस्कुट)

questions.question: To take something on loan with the intention of returning it
questions.solution: 'Borrow' means to take and use something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it. (उधार लेना)

questions.question: A factory where beer is made
questions.solution: 'Brewery' is a place where beer is made commercially. (शराब की भठ्ठी)

questions.question: A list or collection of books or informative graphics
questions.solution: 'Catalogue' is a complete list of items, typically one in alphabetical or other systematic order. (सूचीपत्र)

questions.question: Subject (someone) to a continuous flow of questions, criticisms or information
questions.solution: 'Bombard' means to attack continuously with questions, criticisms, or information. (बौछार करना)

questions.question: A substance that speeds up a chemical reaction without being consumed by the reaction itself
questions.solution: 'Catalyst' is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction. (उत्प्रेरक)

questions.question: The study of the heart and its action and disease
questions.solution: 'Cardiology' is the branch of medicine that deals with diseases and abnormalities of the heart. (हृदय विज्ञान)

questions.question: Something which is considered to be very important
questions.solution: 'Cardinal' means of greatest importance; fundamental. (प्रमुख/अति महत्वपूर्ण)

questions.question: A government run by officials in a state
questions.solution: 'Bureaucracy' is a system of government in which most of the important decisions are taken by state officials rather than by elected representatives. (नौकरशाही)

questions.question: Failing to discharge one's legal or moral duty:
questions.solution: Dereliction is the shameful failure to fulfill one's obligations or duties. (अपने कर्तव्य या जिम्मेदारी का पालन न करना 'Dereliction' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: A place where a dead person's body is burnt
questions.solution: 'Crematorium' is a place where a dead person's body is cremated (burned). (शमशान घाट)

questions.question: A book of names and addresses:
questions.solution: A directory is a book or list of names, addresses, or telephone numbers. (नामों और पतों की सूची वाली पुस्तक को 'Directory' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: A person who is morally corrupt or wicked is described as:
questions.solution: Depraved describes someone with no moral principles. (नैतिक रूप से भ्रष्ट या चरित्रहीन व्यक्ति को 'Depraved' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: The scientific study of skin and its related diseases:
questions.solution: Dermatology is the branch of medicine concerned with the skin. (त्वचा के वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन को 'Dermatology' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: Break or fall apart into small fragments in the process of deterioration
questions.solution: 'Crumble' means to break or fall apart into small fragments, especially through age or neglect. (टुकड़े-टुकड़े होना/बिखरना)

questions.question: A political leader who sways his followers by appealing to emotions and prejudices rather than rational argument:
questions.solution: A demagogue uses oratory to manipulate people's emotions for power. (वह नेता जो अपनी वक्तृत्व कला से लोगों को भड़काता है, 'Demagogue' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: An omission of duty or a failure to do what is required by law is:
questions.solution: Delinquency is the failure to perform an official duty or minor crime. (कर्तव्य की उपेक्षा या चूक को 'Delinquency' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: A person who gives written testimony or evidence for use in a law court is a:
questions.solution: A deponent is a person who gives a sworn statement or deposition. (न्यायालय में लिखित गवाही देने वाला व्यक्ति 'Deponent' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: One who investigates and solves crimes:
questions.solution: A detective is someone whose job is to discover information about crimes. (अपराधों की जांच करने और उन्हें सुलझाने वाले व्यक्ति को 'Detective' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: Ceremony of crowning a king
questions.solution: 'Coronation' is the official ceremony of crowning a king or queen. (राज्याभिषेक)

questions.question: Turning point of danger or disease
questions.solution: 'Crisis' is a time of intense difficulty, trouble, or danger, often a turning point in a disease. (संकट/नाजुक समय)

questions.question: A principle or standard by which anything is or can be judged
questions.solution: 'Criterion' is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided. (मापदंड/कसौटी)

questions.question: Science of the constitution of the whole universe
questions.solution: 'Cosmography' is the science that deals with the general features of the universe, including the earth. (ब्रह्मांड-वर्णन का विज्ञान)

questions.question: Guilty of the crime
questions.solution: 'Culpable' means deserving blame or being responsible for a fault or wrong. (दोषी/अपराधी)

questions.question: Made in imitation so as to be passed off fraudulently as genuine
questions.solution: 'Counterfeit' refers to something made in exact imitation of something valuable with the intention to deceive. (नकली/जालसाजी)

questions.question: A disturbed state of mind characterized by restlessness and illusions, often caused by illness, is:
questions.solution: Delirium is a state of mental confusion during illness. (बीमारी के कारण मानसिक भ्रम या विक्षुब्ध अवस्था 'Delirium' कहलाती है।)

questions.question: To determine the nature of a disease through medical examination:
questions.solution: To diagnose is to identify the nature of an illness by looking at symptoms. (निरीक्षण के द्वारा रोग की पहचान करना 'Diagnose' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: The process of changing secret and coded messages into a readable form is:
questions.solution: Decoding is the act of converting a coded message into plain text. (गुप्त संदेशों को पढ़ने योग्य भाषा में बदलने को 'Decoding' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: Gradual recovery of health and strength
questions.solution: 'Convalescence' is the period of gradual recovery of health and strength after illness or injury. (बीमारी के बाद धीरे-धीरे स्वास्थ्य में सुधार)

questions.question: Unable to think clearly because of mental illness:
questions.solution: Deranged refers to someone who is mentally unbalanced or insane. (मानसिक बीमारी के कारण विक्षिप्त या पागल व्यक्ति को 'Deranged' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: The process of deciding the nature of a disease by examination:
questions.solution: Diagnosis is the identification of an illness or other problem. (बीमारी की पहचान करने की प्रक्रिया को 'Diagnosis' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: One who sneers at the aims and beliefs of his fellow men
questions.solution: 'Cynic' is a person who believes that people are motivated purely by self-interest rather than acting for honorable or unselfish reasons. (दोषदर्शी/मानवद्वेषी)

questions.question: The abandonment of one's country or a specific cause:
questions.solution: Desertion is the act of leaving a place or person without intending to return. (अपने देश या किसी उद्देश्य को बिना अनुमति छोड़ देना 'Desertion' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: Giving orders in a manner that permits no refusal:
questions.solution: Dictatorial refers to an overbearing manner that expects total obedience. (तानाशाही पूर्ण रवैया या ऐसा आदेश जिसमें इनकार की गुंजाइश न हो, 'Dictatorial' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: A funeral procession
questions.solution: 'Cortege' is a solemn procession, especially for a funeral. (अंतिम संस्कार के लिए निकाला गया जुलूस/शव-यात्रा)

questions.question: One who finds nothing good in anything
questions.solution: 'Critic' is a person who expresses an unfavorable opinion of something or someone. (आलोचक)

questions.question: That can be believed or trusted
questions.solution: 'Credible' means something that is able to be believed; convincing. (विश्वसनीय)

questions.question: The sound made by frogs
questions.solution: 'Croak' is the characteristic deep hoarse sound made by a frog or a crow. (मेंढक की आवाज़/टर्राना)

questions.question: To protect someone or something from harm or danger is to:
questions.solution: To defend means to guard against attack or harm. (नुकसान या खतरे से बचाना 'Defend' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: The expression of a wish that misfortune or doom befall a person
questions.solution: 'Curse' is a solemn utterance intended to invoke a supernatural power to inflict harm or punishment on someone or something. (शाप देना)

questions.question: What is the term for a lion's home or resting place?
questions.solution: A den is the wild habitat or home of a lion. (शेर के रहने के स्थान को 'Den' या गुफा कहा जाता है।)

questions.question: A person who enjoys doing dangerous things in a way that others might consider stupid is a:
questions.solution: A daredevil is someone who takes unnecessary risks. (साहसी या दुस्साहसी व्यक्ति जो खतरनाक काम करना पसंद करता है।)

questions.question: A stanza having two lines in verse
questions.solution: 'Couplet' is a pair of successive lines of verse, typically rhyming and of the same length. (दोहा/दो पंक्तियों की कविता)

questions.question: A shortage of essential elements like vitamins and minerals needed for good health is:
questions.solution: Deficiency is the lack of something required for the body. (विटामिन, खनिजों आदि की कमी को 'Deficiency' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: A person without a home, a job or property:
questions.solution: A derelict is a person who has no home or job and is often in poor health. (वह व्यक्ति जिसके पास न घर हो, न नौकरी और न ही संपत्ति, 'Derelict' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: Slow and careful movement, thought, or discussion is termed as:
questions.solution: Deliberation is careful consideration before making a decision. (सोच-समझकर किया गया विचार या धीमी गति को 'Deliberation' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: A dabbler in the art and literature who lacks professional skill:
questions.solution: A dilettante is a person who cultivates an area of interest, such as the arts, without real commitment or knowledge. (कला और साहित्य में केवल ऊपरी रुचि रखने वाला व्यक्ति 'Dilettante' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: A person who is unable to hear is described as:
questions.solution: Deaf refers to the inability to hear. (वह व्यक्ति जो सुन नहीं सकता, उसे 'Deaf' कहा जाता है।)

questions.question: A doctor who studies and treats various skin diseases:
questions.solution: A dermatologist is a specialist doctor for skin issues. (त्वचा रोगों के विशेषज्ञ चिकित्सक को 'Dermatologist' कहा जाता है।)

questions.question: To become liquid, typically during the process of decomposition, is to:
questions.solution: Deliquesce means to dissolve or become liquid. (सड़ने के दौरान तरल बन जाने की प्रक्रिया 'Deliquesce' कहलाती है।)

questions.question: The act of injuring another's reputation by any slanderous communication is:
questions.solution: Defamation is the act of damaging someone's good name. (किसी की प्रतिष्ठा को नुकसान पहुँचाना 'Defamation' या मानहानि कहलाता है।)

questions.question: A bitter and violent verbal attack in words:
questions.solution: A diatribe is a forceful and bitter verbal attack against someone or something. (शब्दों के माध्यम से किया गया तीखा और हिंसक हमला 'Diatribe' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: Feeling disappointed and annoyed about something:
questions.solution: Disgruntled means angry or dissatisfied. (किसी बात से निराश और चिड़चिड़ा महसूस करने वाला व्यक्ति 'Disgruntled' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: A person who takes care of cattle
questions.solution: 'Cowherd' is a person who looks after grazing cattle. (ग्वाला/गाय चराने वाला)

questions.question: A person who is highly skilful with their hands:
questions.solution: Dexterous means showing skill, especially with the hands. (हाथों के काम में निपुण या कुशल व्यक्ति को 'Dexterous' कहा जाता है।)

questions.question: To spread over a wide area or between a large number of people:
questions.solution: Diffuse means spread out over a large area; not concentrated. (व्यापक रूप से फैलना या फैलाना 'Diffuse' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: A young person who has a tendency to commit minor crimes is called a:
questions.solution: A delinquent is a young offender who commits minor crimes. (अपराध करने वाला किशोर 'Delinquent' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: A strong desire to know or learn something
questions.solution: 'Curiosity' is a strong desire to know or learn something. (जिज्ञासा/उत्सुकता)

questions.question: A particular form of a language peculiar to a specific region:
questions.solution: A dialect is a regional variety of a language distinguished by vocabulary or grammar. (किसी विशेष क्षेत्र की विशिष्ट बोली को 'Dialect' कहा जाता है।)

questions.question: A person without money, food and other things necessary for life:
questions.solution: Destitute means lacking even the basic necessities of life. (वह व्यक्ति जो अत्यंत गरीब हो और जिसके पास जीवन की बुनियादी चीजें न हों, उसे 'Destitute' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: A heavy round plate of metal thrown by an athlete:
questions.solution: A discus is a heavy thick-centered disk thrown by an athlete. (एथलीट द्वारा फेंकी जाने वाली भारी गोल प्लेट को 'Discus' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: One appointed to act in place of another:
questions.solution: A deputy is a person who is given the power to do something instead of another person. (वह व्यक्ति जिसे दूसरे के स्थान पर कार्य करने के लिए नियुक्त किया गया हो, 'Deputy' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: A situation in which no further progress is possible, especially between two opposing parties, is a:
questions.solution: A deadlock is a state where progress is impossible. (ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें कोई प्रगति संभव न हो, जिसे 'गतिरोध' या 'Deadlock' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: A group of people
questions.solution: 'Crowd' is a large number of people gathered together in a disorganized way. (भीड़)

questions.question: Change the appearance to deceive or to hide the identity:
questions.solution: To disguise is to give a new appearance to a person or thing to hide its true nature. (अपनी पहचान छिपाने के लिए भेष बदलना 'Disguise' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: The study of secret writing and coded language or words
questions.solution: 'Cryptography' is the art of writing or solving codes. (कूटलेखन/गुप्त लेखन का अध्ययन)

questions.question: To take away or alter the natural qualities of something (like proteins or alcohol) is to:
questions.solution: Denature means to change the natural properties of a substance. (किसी वस्तु के प्राकृतिक गुणों को बदल देना 'Denature' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: A style of cooking food, characteristic of a particular country or region
questions.solution: 'Cuisine' refers to a style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country or region. (पाक शैली/भोजन बनाने का तरीका)

questions.question: The action of discouraging an action by instilling doubt or fear of consequences:
questions.solution: Deterrence is meant to stop someone from doing something by showing them the bad results. (दुष्परिणामों का डर दिखाकर किसी कार्य को रोकने की क्रिया 'Deterrence' कहलाती है।)

questions.question: To become less valuable or lower in price over a period of time is to:
questions.solution: Depreciate refers to the decrease in value of an asset over time. (समय के साथ मूल्य में कमी आने को 'Depreciate' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: A ruler with total power over a country, typically obtained by force:
questions.solution: A dictator is a ruler with total power over a country, typically one who has obtained control by force. (तानाशाह या वह शासक जिसके पास असीमित शक्तियां हों, 'Dictator' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: Open refusal to obey orders or authority is known as:
questions.solution: Defiance is the act of openly resisting authority. (आदेशों को मानने से खुला इनकार 'Defiance' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: To laugh at someone or something in a cruel and mocking way:
questions.solution: To deride means to express contempt for someone; to ridicule. (किसी का क्रूरतापूर्वक मज़ाक उड़ाना या उपहास करना 'Deride' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: Showing a skilful use of underhand tactics to achieve goals:
questions.solution: A devious person uses dishonest or indirect ways to get what they want. (अपने लक्ष्य को पाने के लिए चालाकी या कपटपूर्ण तरीकों का उपयोग करना 'Devious' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: To feel and express strong disapproval of something is to:
questions.solution: To deprecate is to express strong disapproval or protest. (किसी चीज़ के प्रति तीव्र अरुचि या विरोध व्यक्त करना 'Deprecate' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: A person who readily believes others easily
questions.solution: 'Credulous' is a person who is too ready to believe things and is therefore easily deceived. (भोला-भाला/जो आसानी से विश्वास कर ले)

questions.question: Showing great care and effort in your work or duties:
questions.solution: Diligent means showing care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties. (अपने काम में मेहनती और सावधान रहने वाला व्यक्ति 'Diligent' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: What is the term for an extreme fear of dogs?
questions.solution: Cynophobia refers to the irrational fear of dogs. (कुत्तों के प्रति अत्यधिक भय को Cynophobia कहते हैं।)

questions.question: Irresistible craving for alcoholic drinks:
questions.solution: Dipsomania is an uncontrollable craving for alcohol. (शराब पीने की तीव्र और बेकाबू लत को 'Dipsomania' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: Collection of written or spoken texts
questions.solution: 'Corpus' is a collection of written or spoken texts, especially the entire works of a particular author or a body of writing on a particular subject. (किसी लेखक या विषय पर लिखित लेखों का संग्रह)

questions.question: The statistical study of population and its dynamics is known as:
questions.solution: Demography involves studying population changes and statistics. (जनसंख्या और उसकी गतिशीलता के अध्ययन को 'Demography' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: An act that makes one feel morally bad or ashamed:
questions.solution: Disgraceful refers to behavior that is shameful or causes loss of respect. (शर्मनाक या अपमानजनक कार्य जो सम्मान कम करे, 'Disgraceful' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: A situation requiring a choice between equally undesirable alternatives:
questions.solution: A dilemma is a situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two options. (ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें दो कठिन विकल्पों में से चुनाव करना हो, उसे 'Dilemma' या दुविधा कहते हैं।)

questions.question: Having or forming a hard outer layer
questions.solution: 'Crusted' means having a hard layer or coating on the surface. (पपड़ीदार/कठोर बाहरी परत वाला)

questions.question: To confirm with the help of evidence
questions.solution: 'Corroborate' means to confirm or give support to a statement, theory, or finding with evidence. (साक्ष्य द्वारा पुष्टि करना)

questions.question: A dynamic campaign for political, social or religious change
questions.solution: 'Crusade' is a vigorous campaign for political, social, or religious change. (धर्मयुद्ध/आंदोलन)

questions.question: The system of money used in a particular country
questions.solution: 'Currency' is a system of money in general use in a particular country. (मुद्रा)

questions.question: The state of being deprived of a right, especially the right to vote:
questions.solution: Disenfranchisement means the state of being deprived of a right or privilege, especially the right to vote. (मताधिकार या नागरिक अधिकारों से वंचित होना 'Disenfranchisement' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: Which term describes a secret or disguised way of writing or a code?
questions.solution: A cypher is a secret way of writing, often using code. (लिखने का गुप्त या कूट तरीका जिसे 'Cypher' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: A person or thing that is the center of attention or admiration is known as:
questions.solution: Cynosure is someone who is the focus of everyone's attention. (आकर्षण का केंद्र बिंदु जिसे 'Cynosure' कहा जाता है।)

questions.question: A device for deciphering codes and ciphers
questions.solution: 'Cryptograph' is a device or system for writing or solving codes and ciphers. (गुप्तलेख यंत्र)

questions.question: To injure or damage the good reputation of someone is to:
questions.solution: To defame is the verbal or written action of hurting a reputation. (किसी की प्रतिष्ठा को धूमिल करने की क्रिया 'Defame' कहलाती है।)

questions.question: All the arts, beliefs and social institutions etc. characteristic of a race
questions.solution: 'Culture' includes the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society. (संस्कृति)

questions.question: A group of vehicles travelling together, typically one accompanied by armed troops
questions.solution: 'Convoy' refers to a group of ships or vehicles traveling together, typically accompanied by armed protection. (वाहनों का रक्षक दल/काफिला)

questions.question: Signal under martial law for people to remain indoors
questions.solution: 'Curfew' is a regulation requiring people to remain indoors between specified hours, typically at night. (कर्फ्यू/निषेधाज्ञा)

questions.question: A song sung in the past at a funeral or for a dead person:
questions.solution: A dirge is a mournful song, a piece of music, or a sound. (शोकगीत जो किसी की मृत्यु पर गाया जाए, 'Dirge' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: A system of government in which all the people of a country can vote to elect their representatives is:
questions.solution: Democracy is a government of the people, by the people, and for the people. (लोकतंत्र, जहाँ जनता अपने प्रतिनिधि चुनती है, 'Democracy' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: Which term refers to a period of ten years?
questions.solution: A decade is a span of ten years. (दस वर्षों की अवधि को 'Decade' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: A book giving the meaning of various words:
questions.solution: A dictionary is a book that lists the words of a language and their meanings. (शब्दों के अर्थ बताने वाली पुस्तक को 'Dictionary' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: Government by two rulers or authorities simultaneously:
questions.solution: Diarchy is a form of government where power is shared by two bodies. (दो शासकों या सत्ताओं द्वारा चलाया जाने वाला शासन 'Diarchy' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: A place where nuns live and work
questions.solution: 'Convent' is a place where a community of nuns live and work together. (मठ/मन्दिर जहाँ नन रहती हैं)

questions.question: A person who regards the whole world as his country
questions.solution: 'Cosmopolitan' is a person who is free from local or national prejudices and considers the whole world as their home. (सर्वदेशीय/जो पूरे विश्व को अपना घर माने)

questions.question: An act or event that has disastrous consequences:
questions.solution: A disaster is a sudden accident or a natural catastrophe that causes great damage. (भीषण आपदा या विनाशकारी घटना को 'Disaster' कहते हैं।)

questions.question: To criticize someone or something unfairly or to disparage their reputation is to:
questions.solution: Denigrate means to attack the reputation of someone unfairly. (किसी की अनुचित तरीके से आलोचना करना 'Denigrate' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: To portray or represent someone or something in words or a picture is to:
questions.solution: To depict is to describe or show something in detail. (शब्दों या चित्रों के माध्यम से चित्रण करना 'Depict' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: The branch of biology that deals with the study of cells is called:
questions.solution: Cytology is the scientific study of cells. (कोशिकाओं के अध्ययन को 'Cytology' कहा जाता है।)

questions.question: A system of religious belief; a faith
questions.solution: 'Creed' is a set of beliefs or aims which guide someone's actions. (पंथ/धर्ममत)

questions.question: To give one’s authority, power, or responsibility to another person is to:
questions.solution: To delegate is to entrust a task or responsibility to another. (अपना अधिकार किसी और को सौंपना 'Delegate' कहलाता है।)

questions.question: A keeper or custodian of a museum or other collection
questions.solution: 'Curator' is a keeper or custodian of a museum or other collection. (संग्रहालय का अध्यक्ष)

questions.question: A strongbox or small chest for holding valuables
questions.solution: 'Coffer' is a strongbox or small chest for holding valuables. (तिजोरी)

questions.question: An act of exchanging information
questions.solution: 'Communication' is the imparting or exchanging of information by speaking or writing. (संचार/सूचना का आदान-प्रदान)

questions.question: A disease persisting for a long time or recurring again and again
questions.solution: 'Chronic' refers to an illness or condition that persists for a long time. (दीर्घकालिक/पुरानी बीमारी)

questions.question: Exercising a compelling charm which inspires devotion in others
questions.solution: 'Charismatic' describes a person possessing great charm or influence. (प्रभावशाली/आकर्षक)

questions.question: One who sets type for books, newspapers, etc.
questions.solution: 'Compositor' is a person who arranges type for printing. (अक्षर-योजक/कंपोज़िटर)

questions.question: One who plans the steps and moves in a dance
questions.solution: 'Choreographer' is a person who designs and directs the sequences of steps and movements for a dance. (नृत्य-निर्देशक)

questions.question: An extreme fear of being in a small confined place
questions.solution: 'Claustrophobia' is the extreme or irrational fear of confined places. (छोटे स्थानों का डर)
