questions.question: A secret agreement especially in order to do something dishonest or deceive people
questions.solution: 'Collusion' is a secret or illegal cooperation or conspiracy, especially in order to deceive others. (साठगांठ/मिलीजुली भगत)

questions.question: To own up to something as true
questions.solution: 'Confess' means to admit that one has committed a crime or done something wrong. (कबूल करना)

questions.question: A gigantic statue
questions.solution: 'Colossus' is a person or thing of enormous size, importance, or ability. (विशालकाय मूर्ति)

questions.question: Opposed to great or sudden change
questions.solution: 'Conservative' is a person who is averse to change and holds to traditional values. (रूढ़िवादी)

questions.question: Touching along the side or boundary
questions.solution: 'Contiguous' means sharing a common border; touching. (सटा हुआ/संलग्न)

questions.question: Living together of a man and woman without being married to each other
questions.solution: 'Concubinage' is the state of a man and a woman living together without being married. (बिना विवाह साथ रहना)

questions.question: The sound made by a hen
questions.solution: 'Cluck' is the short, low sound made by a hen. (मुर्गी की आवाज़)

questions.question: An arrangement of events or dates in the order of their occurrence
questions.solution: 'Chronology' is the arrangement of events or dates in the order of their occurrence. (समय-क्रम/कालक्रम)

questions.question: Compelling attractiveness or charm that can inspire or influence others
questions.solution: 'Charisma' is a personal quality of presence or charm that others find compelling. (प्रतिभा/आकर्षण)

questions.question: Satisfied, with no desire to change or improve
questions.solution: 'Complacent' means showing smug or uncritical satisfaction with oneself or one's achievements. (आत्मसंतुष्ट)

questions.question: To make perfect or complete
questions.solution: 'Complement' is a thing that contributes extra features to something else in a way that improves it. (पूरक/पूर्ण करना)

questions.question: All the customers of a business
questions.solution: 'Clientele' refers to the customers of a shop, bar, or place of entertainment. (ग्राहकगण)

questions.question: Comfort someone at a time of grief or disappointment
questions.solution: 'Console' means to comfort someone at a time of grief or disappointment. (सांत्वना देना)

questions.question: Making a loud and confused noise
questions.solution: 'Clamorous' means making a loud and confused noise. (शोर मचाने वाला)

questions.question: An apartment building in which each apartment is owned separately by the people living in it, but also containing shared areas
questions.solution: 'Condominium' is a building or complex of buildings containing a number of individually owned apartments or houses. (एक अपार्टमेंट जिसमें निजी और साझा क्षेत्र दोनों हों)

questions.question: Clues available at a scene
questions.solution: 'Circumstantial' refers to evidence that points to a fact without proving it directly. (परिस्थितिजन्य)

questions.question: A careful preservation and protection of wildlife is the need of the hour
questions.solution: 'Conservation' is the preservation, protection, or restoration of the natural environment and wildlife. (संरक्षण)

questions.question: Capable of being imagined or grasped mentally
questions.solution: 'Conceivable' means capable of being imagined or grasped mentally. (कल्पनीय/समझ में आने योग्य)

questions.question: A loud appeal or demand
questions.solution: 'Clamour' is a loud and confused noise, especially that of people shouting vehemently. (कोलाहल/जोरदार मांग)

questions.question: Climb or move with difficulty or a lot of effort, typically using one's hands and feet
questions.solution: 'Clamber' means to climb or move in an awkward and laborious way. (हाथ-पैर के बल चढ़ना)

questions.question: A room in a public building where outdoor clothes or luggage may be left
questions.solution: 'Cloakroom' is a room in a public building where people can leave their coats or bags. (सामान रखने का कमरा)

questions.question: Someone who is satisfied with life is general
questions.solution: 'Contented' means happy and at ease. (संतुष्ट)

questions.question: A small building or room used for Christian worship in a school, prison, or large house
questions.solution: 'Chapel' is a small place for Christian worship, often attached to a larger institution. (छोटा गिरजाघर)

questions.question: An arrangement of parts or elements in a particular form or figure
questions.solution: 'Configuration' is an arrangement of parts or elements in a particular form, figure, or combination. (विन्यास/आकृति)

questions.question: A factual written account of important or historical events in the order of their occurrence
questions.solution: 'Chronicle' is a factual written account of important or historical events. (इतिहास/वृत्तांत)

questions.question: To keep a great person or event in people's memory
questions.solution: 'Commemorate' means to recall and show respect for someone or something. (पुण्यस्मरण करना/याद करना)

questions.question: Compulsory enlistment for military service
questions.solution: 'Conscription' is the compulsory enlistment for state service, typically into the armed forces. (अनिवार्य सैन्य भर्ती)

questions.question: Art of designing or writing on wax
questions.solution: 'Cerography' is the specific art of engraving or writing on wax. (मोम पर लेखन कला)

questions.question: A group of singers in a church
questions.solution: 'Choir' is an organized group of singers, especially one that takes part in church services. (गायक-मंडली)

questions.question: Prohibited by law or treaty from being imported or exported
questions.solution: 'Contraband' refers to goods that have been imported or exported illegally. (वर्जित माल/तस्करी का माल)

questions.question: Mutual discourse
questions.solution: 'Colloquy' is a formal conversation or mutual discourse. (परस्पर बातचीत)

questions.question: Money given to agent on sales
questions.solution: 'Commission' is a sum of money paid to an agent in a commercial transaction. (आढ़त/कमीशन)

questions.question: Something made impure by exposure to polluting substances
questions.solution: 'Contaminated' means made impure by exposure to polluting substances. (दूषित)

questions.question: An opinion or conclusion formed on the basis of incomplete information
questions.solution: 'Conjecture' is an opinion or conclusion formed on the basis of incomplete information. (अनुमान/अंदाजा)

questions.question: The base frame of a car or other wheel vehicle
questions.solution: 'Chassis' is the base frame of a motor vehicle or other wheeled object. (चेसिस/गाड़ी का ढांचा)

questions.question: A man who knows a lot about things like food, music and art
questions.solution: 'Connoisseur' is an expert judge in matters of taste. (पारखी/विशेषज्ञ)

questions.question: A company or person that makes or sells sweets or chocolate
questions.solution: 'Confectioner' is a person whose business is making or selling sweets and chocolates. (हलवाई)

questions.question: Having too much pride in yourself and what you do
questions.solution: 'Conceited' means excessively proud of oneself; vain. (अभिमानी/घमंडी)

questions.question: A group of stars that forms a shape in the sky and has a name
questions.solution: 'Constellation' is a group of stars forming a recognizable pattern that is traditionally named after its apparent form. (नक्षत्र/तारा-समूह)

questions.question: Replacing something with something else
questions.solution: 'Change' is the act or instance of making or becoming different. (परिवर्तन)

questions.question: Run after in order to catch or catch up with
questions.solution: 'Chase' means to pursue someone or something in order to catch them. (पीछा करना)

questions.question: Having a common centre, as circles or spheres
questions.solution: 'Concentric' refers to circles or spheres which have the same centre. (सकेन्द्रित)

questions.question: Feeling inside you which tells you what is right and what is wrong
questions.solution: 'Conscience' is a person's moral sense of right and wrong. (विवेक/अन्तःकरण)

questions.question: The situation in which a disease is spread by touching someone or something
questions.solution: 'Contagion' is the communication of disease from one person to another by close contact. (छूत/संक्रमण)

questions.question: A small compartment in an aircraft for the pilot
questions.solution: 'Cockpit' is the compartment for the pilot and sometimes also the crew in an aircraft. (कॉकपिट)

questions.question: Something that is related to the brain or the intellect
questions.solution: 'Cerebral' relates to the brain or the use of the mind rather than feelings. (मस्तिष्क संबंधी/बौद्धिक)

questions.question: A fortress typically one on high ground above a city
questions.solution: 'Citadel' is a fortress, typically one on high ground above a city. (किला/गढ़)

questions.question: Extreme self-confidence or audacity
questions.solution: 'Chutzpah' is extreme self-confidence or audacity. (धृष्टता/दुस्साहस)

questions.question: To restrain or compel a person to do something by force
questions.solution: 'Coerce' means to persuade someone to do something by using force or threats. (मजबूर करना)

questions.question: A collection of slaves
questions.solution: 'Coffle' is a line of animals or slaves fastened or driven together. (दासों का काफिला)

questions.question: A drink usually made from a mixture of one or more alcoholic drinks
questions.solution: 'Cocktail' is an alcoholic drink consisting of a spirit or several spirits mixed with other ingredients. (मिश्रित पेय)

questions.question: A deep fissure in the earth's surface
questions.solution: 'Chasm' is a deep opening or crack in the earth or a rock. (खाई/दरार)

questions.question: To officially take something away from somebody
questions.solution: 'Confiscate' means to take or seize someone's property with authority. (जब्त करना)

questions.question: A remarkable concurrence of events or circumstances without apparent causal connection
questions.solution: 'Coincidence' is a remarkable concurrence of events or circumstances without apparent causal connection. (इत्तेफाक/संयोग)

questions.question: Belonging to the same time // A person living in the same age with another
questions.solution: 'Contemporary' refers to living or occurring at the same time

questions.question: A corporation made up of a number of different companies that operate in diversified fields
questions.solution: 'Conglomerate' is a large corporation formed by the merging of separate and diverse firms. (मिश्रित कंपनी/समूह)

questions.question: Extremely skilled
questions.solution: 'Consummate' means showing high degree of skill and flair; complete or perfect. (उत्कृष्ट/पूर्ण)

questions.question: The order of their occurrence
questions.solution: 'Chronological' means starting with the earliest and following the order in which they occurred. (कालानुक्रमिक)

questions.question: A spider's home
questions.solution: 'Cobweb' is a spider's web, especially when old and covered with dust. (मकड़ी का जाला)

questions.question: People who belong to the same country
questions.solution: 'Compatriots' are fellow citizens or nationals of a country. (देशभाई/हमवतन)

questions.question: Place where two or more rivers meet
questions.solution: 'Confluence' is the junction of two rivers, especially rivers of approximately equal width. (संगम)

questions.question: An assembly of worshippers // A group of people who have come together in a religious building for worship and prayer
questions.solution: 'Congregation' is a group of people assembled for religious worship. (धर्मसभा/भक्त-मंडली)

questions.question: An instrument for measuring time accurately in spite of motion or variations in temperature, humidity, and air pressure
questions.solution: 'Chronometer' is an instrument for measuring time with extreme accuracy. (क्रोनोमीटर/समयमापक यंत्र)

questions.question: A person employed to drive a private or hired car
questions.solution: 'Chauffeur' is a person employed to drive a private or luxury car. (शफर/ड्राइवर)

questions.question: A remark that expresses approval or admiration
questions.solution: 'Compliment' is a polite expression of praise or admiration. (प्रशंसा/सम्मान)

questions.question: A group of ants
questions.solution: 'Colony' refers to a group of certain animals or insects (like ants) living together. (बस्ती/चींटियों का समूह)

questions.question: An instruction that is added later to a will, usually to change a part of it
questions.solution: 'Codicil' is an addition or supplement that explains, modifies, or revokes a will or part of one. (वसीयतनामा का परिशिष्ट)

questions.question: An event that may/may not happen
questions.solution: 'Contingency' is a future event or circumstance which is possible but cannot be predicted with certainty. (आकस्मिकता)

questions.question: Palm reading
questions.solution: 'Chiromancy' is the art or practice of telling fortunes from the lines on the palm of the hand. (हस्तरेखा विद्या)

questions.question: Rude in a mean-spirited and surly way
questions.solution: 'Churlish' means rude in a mean-spirited and surly way. (असभ्य/उजड्ड)

questions.question: A person who conforms to accepted behaviour or established practices
questions.solution: 'Conformist' is a person who behaves in accordance with established standards. (अनुपालन करने वाला)

questions.question: To criticise someone severely
questions.solution: 'Chastise' means to reprimand or punish someone severely. (दंड देना/कड़ी आलोचना करना)

questions.question: A person who introduces the performers or contestants in a variety show
questions.solution: 'Compere' is a person who introduces the performers or contestants in a variety show. (कार्यक्रम का संचालक)

questions.question: Combustibles – flammable
questions.solution: 'Conflagrant' means burning or blazing. (ज्वलनशील)

questions.question: Easily spread from one person to another (disease) // A disease which spreads with contact
questions.solution: 'Contagious' refers to a disease spread by contact. (संक्रामक)

questions.question: A routine task, especially a household one
questions.solution: 'Chore' is a routine task, especially a household one that is often perceived as tedious. (घर का काम)

questions.question: Imposed a restriction on
questions.solution: 'Constrained' means appearing forced or overly controlled. (विवश/बाधित)

questions.question: A secret plan, made to do something (usually wrong)
questions.solution: 'Conspiracy' is a secret plan by a group to do something unlawful or harmful. (साजिश/षड्यंत्र)

questions.question: The husks of corn or other grains separated by winnowing or threshing
questions.solution: 'Chaff' refers to the outer husks of grain that are separated during the threshing process. (भूसा/अनाज का छिलका)

questions.question: Forgive or pardon some wrongdoing or an offence
questions.solution: 'Condone' means to accept or allow behavior that is considered morally wrong or offensive to continue. (नजरअंदाज करना/माफ करना)

questions.question: A person that one works with at the same place, in a profession or a business
questions.solution: 'Colleague' is a person with whom one works in a profession or business. (सहकर्मी)

questions.question: Use of force or threats to get someone to agree to something
questions.solution: 'Coercion' is the practice of persuading someone to do something by using force or threats. (जबर्दस्ती/दबाव)

questions.question: A child who is believed to have been secretly left in exchange for another
questions.solution: 'Changeling' is a child believed to have been secretly substituted by fairies for the parents' real child. (बदला हुआ बच्चा)

questions.question: Rub a part of the body to restore warmth or sensation
questions.solution: 'Chafe' means to rub a part of the body to create warmth or because of irritation. (रगड़ना/खरोंचना)

questions.question: A feeling of guilt or moral scruple that prevents or follows the doing of something bad
questions.solution: 'Compunction' is a feeling of guilt or moral scruple that follows the doing of something bad. (पछतावा/आत्मग्लानि)

questions.question: One who does one’s work thoroughly and seriously
questions.solution: 'Conscientious' describes a person wishing to do what is right, especially to do one's work or duty well. (ईमानदार/कर्तव्यनिष्ठ)

questions.question: A person falsely claiming to have a special knowledge or skill
questions.solution: 'Charlatan' is a person who pretends to have skills or knowledge they do not possess; a fraud. (पाखंडी/ढोंगी)

questions.question: The use of many words where only a few are necessary
questions.solution: 'Circumlocution' is the use of many words where fewer would do, especially in a deliberate attempt to be vague. (शब्दबाहुल्य/घुमावदार बात)

questions.question: Vexation for humiliation or disappointment
questions.solution: 'Chagrin' is a feeling of being annoyed or disappointed because of a failure or humiliation. (चिढ़/क्षोभ)

questions.question: To have a strong feeling of sympathy with a desire to help
questions.solution: 'Compassion' is sympathetic pity and concern for the sufferings or misfortunes of others. (दया/सहानुभूति)

questions.question: State of anxiety or dismay causing mental confusion
questions.solution: 'Consternation' is a feeling of anxiety or dismay, typically at something unexpected. (घबराहट/विस्मय)

questions.question: Land beside a sea
questions.solution: 'Coast' is the part of the land adjoining or near the ocean or sea. (तट/किनारा)

questions.question: Pertaining to an individual from birth
questions.solution: 'Congenital' refers to a disease or physical abnormality present from birth. (जन्मजात)
